summary: The PR resolves the issue of merging a DataArray into a Dataset using the ds.merge() method. It adds a conversion of DataArray to Dataset within the merge method.

issues.description: The PR does not handle the case where the DataArray does not have a name, which raises a ValueError. This is demonstrated in the new test but could be improved by handling it gracefully within the merge method.
The import statement for DataArray is added inside the method, which is generally not recommended for performance reasons. It should be moved to the top of the file.
